bio: Marco Venier stands as a testament to the rising cittadini class of Venice, having transformed his inherited Murano glass workshop into a diversified commercial enterprise spanning multiple districts of La Serenissima. His astute investments in bakeries at Calle dei Albanesi and strategic public works like the well at Calle dei Botteri demonstrate his pragmatic approach to commerce – addressing the fundamental needs of his workforce while securing reliable supply chains for his operations.
